title: How a Clothes Dryer Works in 60 Seconds 👕🌀 #shorts
description:
A tumble dryer doesn't bake your clothes. It heats air, tumbles the clothes through it, and lets that hot air carry the water away as vapour, through the lint filter and out the vent. Follow Inside 60 for a new "how it works" explained in 60 seconds.

#dryer #laundry #howitworks

steps.label: Hook
steps.text: A clothes dryer doesn't bake your clothes. It carries the water away in *hot air*.

steps.label: Heater
steps.text: Air is drawn in and heated by an *electric coil* or a gas flame.

steps.label: Drum
steps.text: The *drum* turns, tumbling the clothes so hot air reaches every side.

steps.label: Evaporation
steps.text: Heat turns the water in the fabric into *vapour*, and the air soaks it up.

steps.label: Lint filter
steps.text: A fan pulls the damp air through the *lint filter*. Clean it after every load.

steps.label: Vent
steps.text: Then the moist air blows out the *vent* to the outside.

steps.label: Recap
steps.text: Heat, tumble, *vent*. Follow Inside 60 for more.
